docs.summary: A runtime instance of an [`AnimationGraph`](#api~Prowl.Motion.AnimationGraph) bound to a skeleton: per-node state plus a control parameter store. Set parameters by name or index, call [`Update`](#api~Prowl.Motion.AnimationGraphInstance~Update), then read [`Pose`](#api~Prowl.Motion.Pose) / [`RootMotionDelta`](#api~Prowl.Motion.AnimationGraphInstance~RootMotionDelta) / [`Events`](#api~Prowl.Motion.AnimationGraphInstance~Events).
The graph's output pose (valid after [`Update`](#api~Prowl.Motion.AnimationGraphInstance~Update)).
The root motion produced this update.
Normalized time [0,1] of the graph's root output (for sub-graph hosting).
Duration in seconds of the graph's root output content.
The root output's sync track (lets a host phase-lock this graph).
Events sampled this update.
How nodes in this graph ask the world where the ground is, or null when nothing can be asked.
What the host engine hands the nodes it defines itself, such as the character they run on.
The index of a control parameter for the index based setters, or -1.
The value type of a control parameter.

Resets every node to its initial state (state machines back to their default state, clips to the start). Control parameter values are kept.
The graph these instances were built from.
Access to a node instance by index (for advanced/editor inspection).
The node at an index, or null when the index belongs to some other graph.

docs.summary: Reads a value node only if it already produced a value this update, without changing any graph state. For debug views.
Finds a node instance by its authored name (or null if unnamed/absent).
Reads a value node. After a parameter change it evaluates a zero time tick, which advances stateful nodes like a real tick.
Evaluates a bone-mask node and returns its mask (for scripting/editor inspection).
